第十九章 虚境源境
“老大，我来晚了。”郭飞看着金大通明显不行了，沉痛道。郭飞不是铁石心肠，反而是个极重感情的人。
“老十，你太重感情，不……不好，千…万别学我，不要…相信任何人。卫国，上界郡，黑牛村，女儿金英……照顾。”金大通嘴唇哆嗦渐渐的说不出话。颤抖着从衣袋中掏出一个袋子，塞到了郭飞手中。
“大通，在外别太辛苦，吃好、穿好，早点回家，我娘俩等你！”
“爹，你回来给我带好吃的，我在家听娘的话，帮娘干活，你放心。早点回来！”
此时，金大通眼中露出了一丝怅然的欣喜之色。似乎回到了黑牛村，站在了家门前。又看到昼思夜想的妻儿。脸含微笑和期盼，悄然离世。
“老大，放心，我会去。黑牛村！”郭飞重重的握住了金大通的手。
“砰！”尸兵像拖死狗一样将王志拖了回来，扔在了郭飞面前。
他没死，睁眼看着郭飞，眼中竟然没有丝毫畏惧，平静如昔。
“营长，你的强者之路结束了！”郭飞嘴角一寒，也平静道。
“郭飞，你敢谋杀营长，王国会处死你的！”王志依然平静的沉喝。
“呵呵，你以为我是三岁小孩，即使你是国王，在这里处死你，也没有人知道。你死定了！”
“为了金大通，你杀我不值。谈谈你的条件吧，我可以给你的更多。回去让你当我的亲兵，待遇比现在好了很多，大好的前程就在眼前！”
“哦，你以为我像你，为了往上爬不顾一切？”郭飞坦然一笑道。
“哦，我知道你想什么，你期望变强，可惜你没有门路，我可以将我习练的功法传给你。如果错过了这次机会，这一辈子你可能也接触不到五行练气功法，为了你自己，你不该杀我！”
郭飞一怔，他不得不承认，王志此人确有过人之处，仅仅和郭飞相见几次，他竟然摸透了郭飞的想法，他这句话对郭飞诱惑太大了，这正是郭飞这么多天来苦苦思索追寻的问题，也是他最大的心结，王志的话正中了他的软肋。
“不知道你自己懂不懂，你先回答我几个问题，我再做决定！”郭飞冷笑一声道。
“说！”
“人族修炼五行真气，为什么还有武者和术士之分，修炼道路是怎样的？”郭飞提出了自己长久的疑惑。
“哼！”王志冷然的脸上露出了一丝会心的微笑，轻声道：“修士最低为武者和术士，武者上面有气修士、武宗、武尊、武帝和武圣之分；术士上面有术师、术宗、术尊、术帝和术圣之分。这些称呼只是尊称，其实每个境界都暗含一个修炼之境。

修炼途径殊途同归，都是化天地五行之气为本源五行元气，以此来催动功法和术法。武者和术士本质相同，只不过习练功法不同，所以分道扬镳了。术士以术法印诀催动本源五行元气来攻击，威力极大，但术士因为长久静坐苦修术法印诀，身体孱弱。武者，以武技方式直接释放本源五行元气，并要不断的锤炼身体，所以身体强悍。”
“何为本源五行元气？”郭飞颤声道，终于触摸到了一丝这个世界真正修士的秘典了。
“哼！”王志嘴角一撇，露出了一丝轻蔑的微笑。“气修士，根本没有触摸到五行修士的边，世人愚昧，妄加揣测，贻笑大方。五行修士将气修士境界称之为‘虚境’，意思是真气为虚，攻击力虚弱，自以为了不起了，其实只是虚幻一梦罢了。只有进入‘源境’，才能化天地五行真气为本源五行元气，步入武宗行列，成为真正的五行修士。我已经触摸到了边缘，我可以带你进入这个大门。”
郭飞心中虽然震惊，但却是淡淡一笑，刚才王志嘴角一撇，让郭飞想到了中山狼、无情兽的话语。此人狼性，留不得。
“你为什么不修炼术法？”郭飞继续道。
“我们穷人，修炼什么功法，没得选择，普通人一辈子也不可能接触到修炼五行真气的功法，所以有什么就练习什么了。我得到一本《剑经》，就以此来修炼剑法。”
郭飞一听，一摆手，士兵伸手在他身上摸出一个袋子，递给了郭飞，郭飞一摸，里面果然有本兽皮书。
“营长，不是我不想放过你，其实我真有点佩服你，为了自己的目的不择手段，心狠手辣。只是，你祸害任何人我都不会管，但你祸害我郭飞的朋友，你就罪无可赦。在这个世界上，我的朋友不多，金大通勉强算是一个。”郭飞说完，一摆手。
尸兵窜上去，按住了王志的脖颈，正在缓慢恢复气力的王志顿时大惊，剧烈的挣扎起来。
“杨…兄，怎…么是你！”王志脸对脸的对着尸兵，竟然认出了杨营长，顿时“咳”出了这句话。
看着渐渐没有呼吸的王志，郭飞心中暗自期盼。尸兵堂中光芒一闪。
“果然可以！”郭飞心中暗喜，手掌一挥，一道白色光芒笼罩了王志，瞬间将其收入了尸兵堂中。
“营长，你作为我的尸兵，说不定也可以达到武道高峰。我帮你满足这个愿望。”郭飞心中冷笑一声道。
“唉！”看了一眼金大通的尸体，郭飞叹口气，金大通临死总结一句话：不要相信任何人！”
这难道就是他一生经验的总结么，郭飞不禁的茫然了。将金大通随身带的老二的骨灰袋子、他的食物袋和水袋取下。
郭飞取出黑色的粉末，洒在金大通身体上，点起了火捻，顿时火光冲天，尸体焚烧起来。
用布袋又包了点金大通的骨灰装进了老二装骨灰的袋子中。然后郭飞指挥尸兵用剑挖坑，将金大通的骨灰掩埋掉，既然答应了他，自然要把他的骨灰带回去一点。
郭飞将金大通塞到自己手中的袋子拿出来观看，里面有十几块魂晶，还有一块玉佩，郭飞暗自叹口气，正准备转身离去。陡然间，前面一阵大乱，五人慌不择路的人窜了过来，后面三个死灵死命的追来。
“赵雪、赵霸！”郭飞认出了当前两人，顿时一怔，将尸兵收进了兵符空间中。
“救命！”赵雪和赵霸在前，后面三个护卫死命阻击追袭而来的死灵，转眼间一个护卫被一个大猩猩状的死灵撕为两半。赵霸冲着郭飞的火光而来，显然是发现了火光后才冲过来的。

剩余四人明显已经不行了，脚步踉跄，几乎站立不稳。郭飞本不愿和他们有交集，带着这几个“拖油瓶”说不定会害死自己。
但，心意一动，他改变了主意，先前赵雪曾救过自己，知恩图报这是郭飞做人的准则；其次，这倒不失为进入上层社会的一个阶梯，如果总在底层混，没有见识，接触不到高深的武技，何时才能有出头之日，从异时空来的郭飞，自然了解生存的法则。
三头死灵并不强大，只是四人太虚弱。郭飞瞬间抽出了玄铁剑，身影晃动，杀入战团。
（新人新书，求推荐、
content_en:
Chapter 19 The Origin of the Virtual Realm
"Boss, I'm late." Guo Fei said sadly as he saw that Jin Datong was obviously dying. Guo Fei is not a hard-hearted person, but a very emotional person.
"Old Shi, you are too emotional. No... that's not good. Don't... never learn from me, don't... trust anyone. Weiguo, Shangjie County, Heiniu Village, my daughter Jin Ying... will take care of you." Jin Datong's lips trembled and he gradually became speechless. Tremblingly, he took out a bag from his pocket and stuffed it into Guo Fei's hand.
"Da Tong, don't work too hard outside, eat well, dress well, and go home early. My mother-in-law is waiting for you!"
"Dad, you come back and bring me delicious food. I will listen to my mother at home and help her with her work. Don't worry. Come back soon!"
At this time, Jin Datong's eyes showed a hint of sadness and joy. It seemed like I was back in Heiniu Village, standing in front of my house. I also saw my wife and children who were thinking about me day and night. With a smile and hope on his face, he passed away quietly.
"Boss, don't worry, I will go to Heiniu Village!" Guo Fei held Jin Datong's hand heavily.
"Bang!" The corpse soldiers dragged Wang Zhi back like a dead dog and threw him in front of Guo Fei.
He was not dead. He opened his eyes and looked at Guo Fei. There was no fear in his eyes and he was as calm as before.
"Batalion Commander, your journey to becoming a strong man is over!" Guo Fei said calmly with a cold expression on his lips.
"Guo Fei, if you dare to murder the battalion commander, the kingdom will execute you!" Wang Zhi shouted still calmly.
"Haha, you think I am a three-year-old child. Even if you are the king, no one will know if you are executed here. You are dead!"
"It's not worth it for you to kill me for Jin Datong. Let's talk about your conditions. I can give you more. If you go back and let you be my personal soldier, the treatment will be much better than now. A bright future is ahead of you!"
"Oh, you think I'm like you, desperate to climb up?" Guo Fei said with a calm smile.
"Oh, I know what you are thinking. You hope to become stronger, but unfortunately you have no way. I can pass on the skills I practice to you. If you miss this opportunity, you may not be able to come into contact with the Five Elements Qigong practice in this life. For your own sake, you should not kill me!"
Guo Fei was startled. He had to admit that Wang Zhi was indeed extraordinary. After only meeting Guo Fei a few times, he actually figured out Guo Fei's thoughts. His words were too tempting for Guo Fei. This was the question that Guo Fei had been thinking about and pursuing for so many days, and it was also his biggest problem. Wang Zhi's words hit his weakness.
"I don't know if you understand or not. You answer a few questions for me first, and then I will make a decision!" Guo Fei sneered.
"Say!"
"Humans practice the Five Elements Qi. Why are they divided into warriors and sorcerers? What is the path of cultivation?" Guo Fei raised his long-standing doubts.
"Hmph!" A knowing smile appeared on Wang Zhi's cold face, and he said softly: "The lowest level of monks are warriors and warlocks. Above warriors, there are Qi monks, Martial Masters, Martial Masters, Martial Emperors and Martial Saints; above Warlocks, there are Warlocks, Martial Masters, Martial Masters, Martial Emperors and Martial Saints. These titles are just honorific titles. In fact, each realm implies a realm of cultivation.
Different cultivation paths lead to the same goal, which is to transform the Qi of the Five Elements of Heaven and Earth into the original Five Elements Qi, in order to activate the exercises and techniques. Warriors and sorcerers are essentially the same, but they practice different techniques, so they part ways. The warlock uses the magic seal to activate the five elements of the original energy to attack, which is extremely powerful. However, the warlock's body is weak because he has been sitting quietly for a long time to practice the magic seal. Warriors use martial arts to directly release the original five elements of vitality, and must constantly temper their bodies, so their bodies are strong. "
"What is the original five elements vitality?" Guo Fei asked in a trembling voice, finally touching a trace of the secret book of the real monks in this world.
"Hmph!" Wang Zhi curled his lips and showed a contemptuous smile. "The Qi monks have not touched the edge of the Five Elements monks at all. The world is ignorant, making assumptions and making people laugh. The Five Elements monks call the realm of the Qi monks the 'virtual realm',It means that the true energy is weak, the attack power is weak, and you think you are great, but in fact it is just an illusion and a dream. Only by entering the ‘source realm’ can one turn the five elements’ true energy of heaven and earth into the original five elements’ vitality, step into the ranks of the Wuzong, and become a true five-element monk. I have touched the edge and I can lead you into this gate. "
Although Guo Fei was shocked, he smiled faintly. The corner of Wang Zhi's lips just turned up, which reminded Guo Fei of the words of Zhongshan Wolf and Ruthless Beast. This person has a wolfish nature and cannot be left here.
"Why don't you practice magic? "Guo Fei continued.
"We poor people have no choice as to what exercises to practice. Ordinary people will never be exposed to the exercises to cultivate the Five Elements Qi in their lifetime, so we just practice whatever we have. I got a "Sword Sutra" and used it to practice swordsmanship. "
When Guo Fei heard this, he waved his hand. The soldier reached out and took out a bag on his body and handed it to Guo Fei. Guo Fei touched it and found that there was indeed an animal skin book inside.
"Battal Commander, it's not that I don't want to let you go. In fact, I really admire you for being ruthless and unscrupulous in order to achieve your own goals. It's just that I won't care if you harm anyone, but if you harm my friend Guo Fei, you will be guilty. In this world, I don’t have many friends, and Jin Datong is barely one. "After Guo Fei finished speaking, he waved his hand.
The corpse soldiers rushed up and held Wang Zhi's neck. Wang Zhi, who was slowly recovering his strength, was suddenly shocked and struggled violently.
"Brother Yang, how can it be you! "Wang Zhi faced the corpse soldiers face to face, and actually recognized Battalion Commander Yang, and immediately coughed out these words.
Seeing Wang Zhi gradually losing his breath, Guo Fei secretly hoped in his heart. There was a flash of light in the Corpse Soldier Hall.
"Sure enough! "Guo Fei was secretly happy. With a wave of his hand, a white light enveloped Wang Zhi and instantly put him into the Corpse Soldier Hall.
"Battal Commander, as my corpse soldier, you might be able to reach the peak of martial arts. I'll help you fulfill this wish. "Guo Fei sneered in his heart.
"Alas! "After taking a look at Jin Datong's body, Guo Fei sighed. Jin Datong concluded one sentence before he died: Don't trust anyone!"
Could this be the summary of his life experience? Guo Fei couldn't help but feel confused. Remove the bag of ashes of the second child, his food bag and water bag that Jin Datong carries with him.
Guo Fei took out black powder, sprinkled it on Jin Datong's body, and lit a fire. Suddenly, the flames shot into the sky and the body was burned.
The ashes of Jin Datong were wrapped in a cloth bag and put into the bag containing the ashes. Then Guo Fei commanded the corpse soldiers to dig a hole with swords and bury Jin Datong's ashes. Since he agreed to him, he naturally wanted to take some of his ashes back.
Guo Fei took out the bag that Jin Datong put into his hand and looked at it. There were more than a dozen soul crystals and a jade pendant inside. Guo Fei sighed secretly and was about to turn around and leave. Suddenly, there was a huge chaos in front of them. Five people rushed over in panic, and three undead souls chased after them desperately.
"Zhao Xue, Zhao Ba!" Guo Fei recognized the two people in front of him, was startled, and took the corpse soldiers into the soldier talisman space.
"Help!" Zhao Xue and Zhao Ba were in front, and the three guards behind them tried their best to block the pursuing undead. In the blink of an eye, one guard was torn in half by a gorilla-like undead. Zhao Ba came towards Guo Fei's fire. Apparently he rushed over after discovering the fire.
The remaining four people were obviously in trouble, their steps were staggering and they were almost unsteady on their feet. Guo Fei didn't want to interact with them. Bringing these "troublemakers" might get him killed.
However, with a thought, he changed his mind. Zhao Xue had saved him before, and repaying kindness was Guo Fei's principle as a man. Secondly, this was a step into the upper class society. If he always hung around at the bottom, had no knowledge, and had no access to advanced martial arts, when would he be able to stand out? Guo Fei, who came from another time and space, naturally understood the rules of survival.
The three-headed undead are not powerful, but the four are too powerful.weak. Guo Fei instantly drew out the Black Iron Sword, his figure swayed, and he entered the battle group.
